summary: A grouped Schur-normal-form family with (S,R) independent of Y and Z, joint cap ||h_SR||_inf=1, all coordinate marginal caps<=1, gradient-triple density cap delta/8, and E||grad Q||^{-1}<=1 nevertheless has ||p_Q||_inf >= (4sqrt(2))^{-1}(1+log(1/delta)) -> infinity. The engineered (S,R) is not asserted to be a genuine linear image of independent cap-one original coordinates, so this refutes only the ambient-gradient-to-level interface, not QFORM.
